name: fitspace-ai-spatial-core
description: FitSpace precision CAD + on-demand WebGL 3D and constrained furniture preview

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && esbuild apps/web/three-viewer.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/apps/web/three-viewer.bundle.js --minify && esbuild apps/web/architecture-three.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/apps/web/architecture-three.bundle.js --minify
scripts.browser:test: npm run build && node tests/browser.e2e.mjs && node tests/polygon.browser.e2e.mjs && node tests/measurement.browser.e2e.mjs && node tests/designer.browser.e2e.mjs && node tests/webgl.browser.e2e.mjs && node tests/capture.browser.e2e.mjs && node tests/reconstruct.browser.e2e.mjs
